scope: Real Kinect and reconstruction, isolated ROS domain 221. Seven 25-second measurement windows with a 15-second warm-up each. Vision only, no Planning, Motion, or display.
validation: Experimental binary built without installing it. Driver stream-policy tests and comparison-script Flake8 passed.
candidate_reason: Relative to 0 ms, 5 ms adds about 1.1 to 1.3 skeleton updates/s with comparable observation age. 10 ms yields more skeleton updates on average, with lower RGB and geometry rates and one longer observed skeleton gap. The 5 ms choice prioritizes both pose cadence and geometry continuity for the next test.
limitations: Passive DDS subscriber rates differ from capture SDK consumption and GUI rendering rate.
Geometry outputs can reuse a skeleton and are not independent pose observations.
Only the three experimental candidates were repeated in reverse order. One blocking baseline was measured in this series.
Scene motion and occlusion were not controlled. SDK timeout recovery was not exercised.
The observed maximum gap is a sample statistic and does not predict a worst-case bound.
The Planning 2 s timeout, reconstruction 0.5 s watchdog and 0.15 s sync allowance remained configured as before.

No images, skeleton positions or capsule geometry are saved; only metadata.
